main_body: A steel-blue panelled wall face (sci-fi bulkhead) with an orange trim band at the top, riveted panels, orange shelf bars, a vent grille, and a dark lower skirting. It is a flat wall surface seen from the front.
top_band: none (a thin 1-2 row lighter blue cap at rows 0-1 and an orange stripe at rows 5-6, both vertical-face trim bands, not a horizontal surface)
evidence: The candidate is a terrain/wall tile, drawn as a flat front-facing panel wall. A pixel column through the middle runs through trim bands, panel face, orange bars and skirting. Everything is a vertical surface, with no top surface. For a wall-face terrain tile this is the expected construction, but by the strict contract it reads as a front elevation.

style.evidence: Reference walls (timber frame with plaster speckle, stone shaded stone by stone) have 5-6 steps and dense texture. The candidate uses about 3 blue tones plus orange. Large panel areas (around 15x10 px) are one flat blue-grey with only a few corner rivet dots. Outlines are dark blue-black lines, mostly neutral and uniform around the panels and bars. Tile density is mostly 2-4 colours, well below the references.
